Duration 1 round

Saving Throw Will vs. your class DC

Your reading presses hard enough to be felt. When you Diagnose an unwilling creature, it attempts a Will save against your class DC; on a failure it becomes sickened 1 for 1 round. A creature that has attempted this save cannot be forced to attempt it again for 10 minutes. Diagnosing a willing creature, or a corpse, requires no save and has no effect.
